name: Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor
summary: Warden Thelwater seals a report on the man visiting Bazil Thredd in the Stormwind Stockade. The confidential account may help investigators follow someone moving through Stormwind’s political and criminal circles.

sections.title: A Mysterious Patron
sections.body: For years, prisoner Bazil Thredd received no visitors in the Stockade. Then a quiet man began coming once or twice each week with valid papers under the name Maelik. Warden Thelwater took note and recorded the man’s appearance. He sealed the description so meddling eyes could not read it before proper investigators acted.

sections.title: From Stonemasons to Spies
sections.body: City architect Baros Alexston found no clear match in the description. He suspected the visitor might be tied to the Defias rebellion, so he sent the sealed envelope to Master Mathias Shaw, leader of Stormwind’s intelligence service, SI:7. Shaw recognized the man as a lethal mercenary who uses names including Marzon. Now the mercenary does dirty work for Lord Gregor Lescovar.

faq.answer: Warden Thelwater, head warden of the Stormwind Stockade, wrote and sealed the document. He grew suspicious when an unknown man began visiting the imprisoned Defias leader, Bazil Thredd, regularly.

faq.q: Who is the visitor described in the paper?
faq.answer: The visitor carried papers under the name Maelik. Warden Thelwater recorded his appearance so investigators could identify him.

faq.q: Why was the visitor meeting with Bazil Thredd?
faq.answer: After years without visitors, Bazil Thredd began receiving them regularly. The sealed description is being investigated to learn the visitor’s purpose.

faq.q: Where does this sealed document need to be taken?
faq.answer: Take the document first to city architect Baros Alexston in Stormwind. After examining the unfamiliar description, Alexston directs you to deliver it to Master Mathias Shaw at SI:7 headquarters in Old Town.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can see how false names, forged papers, and prison visits drew Mathias Shaw’s attention when he compared the man’s appearance with SI:7 intelligence.
As an Alliance member, you can see the weakness in Stormwind’s security: conspirators can pass through the Stockade gates with falsified credentials.
